gain a {{tip|minimum health threshold}} equal to {{as|{{sti|health|10% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}

mechanics.claim: Effects apply before the cast time completes.
mechanics.quote: ''Lamb's Respite's'' effects are applied before the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Units at or below the minimum health threshold become invulnerable while remaining in the zone and cannot be healed, but can still regenerate health.
mechanics.quote: will also become {{tip|invulnerable}} while remaining in the area when they reach or are at the threshold, during which they also cannot be {{tip|heal|healed}}, but can still {{sti|health regeneration|regenerate health|link=health regeneration}}

mechanics.claim: All targetable units within the zone are healed when the blessing ends.
mechanics.quote: All targetable units within the zone are {{tip|heal|healed}} when the blessing ends.

mechanics.claim: Untargetable units are affected by the threshold/invulnerability but do not receive the end-of-duration heal.
mechanics.quote: ''Lamb's Respite'' will affect {{tip|untargetable}} units but does not grant them the {{tip|heal}} at the end of the blessing.

mechanics.claim: Health costs ignore the threshold, but cannot be paid if the caster is below the threshold.
mechanics.quote:
{{tip|Health resource|Health costs}} will ignore ''Lamb's Respite's'' threshold.
** The cost will not be paid if the caster is below the threshold.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown begins at the start of the cast time, not on effect application.
mechanics.quote: Begins at start of cast time
